form_fields.currency: ISO 4217 account currency for all input amounts
form_fields.agreed_gross_fee: Contracted creator fee, not yet equivalent to an invoice or cash
form_fields.invoiced_gross_fee: Gross invoice issued within the original agreed fee
form_fields.cash_received: Funds actually cleared for this contract, after source deductions
form_fields.tax_withheld_at_source: Documented payer withholding on this invoiced amount, not cash paid again
form_fields.agent_fee_deducted_before_receipt: Documented fee withheld upstream, not included in paid expenses
form_fields.other_deductions_before_receipt: Other separately evidenced deductions before deposit
form_fields.negotiation_cash_paid: Paid direct negotiation cost, excluding wages and fees withheld upstream
form_fields.fulfillment_cash_paid: Paid deliverable fulfillment, revisions and shipping
form_fields.tax_paid_directly: Only independently paid tax cash outlays, never the same source withholding
form_fields.negotiation_hours: Hours spent negotiating, including unsuccessful work attributed to the contract

constraints: All numeric inputs must be explicit nonnegative finite numbers; omission is not zero.
All cash amounts must share the same documented currency; exchange rates are out of scope.
Each monetary amount is rounded to cents and validated, without floating-point cumulative leakage.
For an unamended agreement, invoiced gross cannot exceed agreed gross.
Cash received plus source deductions cannot exceed invoiced gross.
Payer withholding and fees are not deducted twice as separately paid cash costs.
Outstanding invoiced balance is unpaid value, not recognized profit.
Contract cash movement excludes valuation of labor and unpaid obligations, so cannot be labeled net profit.
Inputs must come from a specific contract and payment records; vendor fee medians must never be prefilled as typical creator earnings.
